name: RFID Frequency Identification
description: Before attempting to clone an access card, you must identify the frequency and protocol in use at the target's readers. Most commercial access control systems operate on 125kHz (HID Prox, EM4100) or 13.56MHz (HID iCLASS, MIFARE). An RFID field detector or diagnostics card identifies the frequency of any reader by simply presenting it — no credentials or cloning required. This single step determines which tools you need and whether cloning is feasible with your current kit.

blue.det: Individual holding device near access readers without badging; repeated failed badge reads.
blue.cm: Monitor access control logs for repeated failed reads; anti-skimming reader covers; OSDP encrypted readers.
